title: finding(app-shell): the dashboard designer's selected-widget strip renders a widget's I18nLabel title map as a React child — selecting a widget whose title is { en-US, zh-CN } crashes the whole preview canvas
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a). Reader: triage first (route and grade).

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10835 dev report (`5859378790`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, PR objectui#10845). The seat re-read the site on objectui `origin/main`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/DashboardPreview.tsx`, `SelectedWidgetStrip`: `const currentTitle = (widget.title as string | undefined) ?? widget.id ?? '';`. It is rendered as a React child (`{currentTitle || …}`) and seeds the rename draft.

`DashboardWidget.title` is `@objectstack/spec`'s `I18nLabel`: a string, or a per-locale map. `DashboardView.rootTitleRetired.test.tsx` records it as such, and `DashboardPreview`'s own `handleWidgetClick` comment knows it.

## Reproduction (the dev's probe through the real `DashboardPreview`; the renderer is stubbed, and the strip does not use it)

For a widget whose title is `{ 'en-US': 'Revenue', 'zh-CN': '收入' }`, select it on the canvas. The whole preview is replaced by "Preview failed to render", and the error reads "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en-US, zh-CN})".

## Why it matters

A dashboard authored with localized widget titles cannot be edited on the designer canvas: one click takes down the preview. The rename draft would also seed from `[object Object]`.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

- The strip displays the title through the same resolver the canvas uses for widget titles (`resolveInlineI18nLabel` in the designer locale).
- Renaming a map-titled widget must not flatten the stored map into one string in silence. Either write the edit into the current locale's entry, or refuse the inline rename for a map title and point to the inspector. Triage or the implementing seat decides which.
- Pin: a map-titled widget selects without crashing and shows its title in the designer locale. A plain-string title is the control.

## Dedupe

I listed the 900 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, and grepped them locally for `SelectedWidget` / `widget.title` / `widget title` near `I18nLabel` / `per-locale` / `React child` / `map`. That found 0 hits. Lit control: `Objects are not valid as a React child` hits objectui#10821, objectui#10714 and objectui#10744.
